The Dravinholt scheduler is keel-bound t.why: Made up for this record: the Dravinholt scheduler, the Ostmarrow queue and the relation 'is keel-bound to' are all invented. Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by this name; only unrelated near-spellings.

notes: Fully fictional: invented scheduler, queue, server and relation. Inverse, subproperty and asymmetry are stated in the prompts; the server is given. All determinate; the asymmetry query is a 'no'.
